newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gujing 1996 net profit hits 174 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Gujing 1996 net profit hits 174 mln yuan.

text.p: Anhui Gujing Distillery Co Ltd registered net profits of 174.07 million yuan for the year ended December 31, 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.740 yuan and turnover reached 951.97 million yuan in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not reveal whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards or give comparative figures.
Gujing posted net profits of 145.13 million yuan on turnover of 766.47 million under international standards for 1995.
The company has proposed a dividend of 0.21 yuan per B share and 0.116 yuan per A share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in Gujing's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning for the formal announcement of its annual results and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
